description.en: An internal message/dialogue control-code identifier, not a callable Squirrel function. Found only as a debug-symbol string in the game's ELF binary, named `lxpCMessage::DATA::CMND_RUBI` — an enum value of a `DATA` enum nested in a `lxpCMessage` class, the engine's message/dialogue text parser. It appears nowhere in `script_clean/` or the IDA/Ghidra decompiles as a registered function, so it can't be called from a `.nut` script. Based on the naming ("rubi" = ruby/furigana), this likely marks the start of a ruby-annotated text span, closed by CMND_RUBI_END.
Not a callable function — this is a message-parser tag identifier, not confirmed to have any script-visible behavior.

example.code:
// CMND_RUBI is not a callable function; it's a message parser tag marking the start of a ruby-annotated text span.
// It cannot be used from a .nut script.
